text:
emma: Heads up, new Windows onboarding sample fails for some users on Python 3.11 (Windows 10). Async example throws: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:997). Sync example (requests) works.

jon: Are they on the MS store or python.org build? Windows OpenSSL/py build differences bite here. Does `pip show certifi` show something?

emma: certifi is installed. Tried `pip install certifi` and reboot venv.

marta: We've seen this across 3.8-3.12. Windows often doesn't use OS store and async httpx needs explicit SSLContext. Workaround: set SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where() or pass ssl=SSLContext(...) into AsyncClient. Also ensure cryptography is updated.

emma: I set SSL_CERT_FILE but async still fails. Sync path picks up REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE fine.

ryan: Two suspects: event loop policy (Windows proactor) and httpx default TLS context. Quick test: force selector loop and create default context using certifi, then pass to AsyncClient. Example that worked for me:

```
import ssl, certifi, asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())
asyncio.set_event_loop_policy(asyncio.WindowsSelectorEventLoopPolicy())

async def main():
    async with AsyncClient(ssl=ssl_ctx) as c:
        await c.generate("hello")

asyncio.run(main())
```

ryan: That avoids relying on system OpenSSL cert lookup and sidesteps selector/proactor socket pairing oddities.

marta: We should update the Windows onboarding docs with that snippet and detect Windows in the sample (fall back to env var). Also our stubs are missing the `ssl` kwarg on AsyncClient, so mypy complains.

jon: Filed issue 2429: "windows-ssl-async-typing-sample" to track adding the snippet, typing fix, and GH Actions matrix job for Windows py3.8-3.12. devex-bot: created issue 2429.

devex-bot: Issue 2429 created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/issues/2429

ryan: I'll prepare a small PR to: 1) use certifi.where() as a fallback on Windows when no SSL context provided, 2) add Optional[ssl.SSLContext] to AsyncClient typing stubs, and 3) add Windows to the CI matrix across 3.8-3.12.

emma: Awesome, that'll unblock our internal sample/demo. One more note: parity check — sync client respects REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE env; ensure the async path matches behavior or document the difference. :thumbsup:

marta: tagging @platform for CI matrix update.

jon: If anyone still hits CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED after this, try upgrading cryptography and opening a minimal repro. ryan will attach one if needed.
